body:
Replanned 2026-10-30 at the owner's request.

- Five sprints collapsed into one sprint with one checkpoint.
- New: project metrics summary command on the desktop command channel, read-only MCP scorecard/metrics tools, and a Metrics dashboard linked directly below the sidebar MCP indicator. DM-179 keeps the core/IPC side; MCP moved to the new tools ticket.
- Owner decision, this epic only: TDD-first is waived. Work tickets write no new tests; they run typecheck, lint on their files and the existing tests they touch, and leave rerunnable demonstration scripts under `scratch/`.
- Testing tail after implementation: five layer test tickets and the end-to-end exercise (DM-193, now on a packaged macOS app), then one full check sweep.
- Per-sprint Fireguard tickets DM-194–DM-197 removed. DM-198 is the only ticket that runs Fireguard, after the sweep. The acceptance node reruns the Definition of Done on the final head.
- Accepted risk: defects surface late and cluster in the tail; coverage is first checked by the sweep.
- Repository rules synced so workers don't contradict this: `.cursor/rules/delivery-standards.mdc`, the `.claude`, `.cursor` and `.agents` delivery-standards skills, and `README.md`.
